Source: `servicenow-incidents-*`, **one document per incident** — not the 87.8M-document open-incident snapshot index the landing page uses, so no de-duplication is needed here.

**`resolution_time` is wall-clock seconds**, and equals `resolved_at - opened_at` exactly (verified on the sample). MTTR needs no date arithmetic and no business-hours assumption — it is elapsed time, including nights and weekends.

**The window selects incidents *opened* in it** (`@timestamp` = `opened_at`). A long-running incident opened before the window and resolved inside it will not appear. Widen the time picker for a stable MTTR; 24 hours is a small sample.
